title: Dexcom G6 Checking Auth Errors
symptom: With the latest nightly build, error messages appear in the log when trying to receive readings from the G6 transmitter, including 'Could not read after AuthRequestTX' and 'authentication notification throwable: (CHECK_AUTH)'. The system status page shows accumulating errors every 5 minutes, and it is not possible to receive any readings from the transmitter. The issue persists even after phone reboot, forgetting the transmitter, reinstalling xdrip+, and trying another Android phone.
cause: The thread does not definitively establish a root cause. One user speculates that the transmitter was in a faulty status as the Dexcom G6 app did not work either, and another suggests xDrip is not the cause because the official Dexcom app could not handle the transmitter either.
fix: The thread does not state a fix. One user reports that replacing the transmitter resolved the issue, but this is not presented as a general fix.
evidence_quote: Unfortunately I had to replace the transmitter. I assume that the transmitter was in a faulty status as the Dexcom G6 app did not work either.
